draft.detail: Attachments from context.annotate are stored in .vitest/attachments by default

test.error: FAIL: with attachmentsDir unset, the attachment was copied into .vitest-attachments, not .vitest/attachments

source.quote:
- **Config:** [attachmentsDir](/config/attachmentsdir)

The directory where attachments from `context.annotate` are stored in (default: `.vitest/attachments`)
